更新期间请勿断开电源、插拔外接设备，也不要合盖或进行任何按键操作。: During the update, don't unplug the charger, connect or disconnect devices, close the lid or press any keys.
更新启动后设备将暂时无法使用，请您提前保存好重要数据，并严格按照提示完成操作。: The laptop can't be used once the update starts. Save important data first and follow the instructions carefully.
更新完成后可能自动重启，期间出现花屏属正常现象。: The laptop may restart automatically after the update; screen artifacts during this are normal.
